64:1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah. The dominion is His, and praise is to Him. He is capable of all things.
64:2: It is He who created you, yet some of you are disbelievers and some of you are believers, and Allah is the Seer of what you do.
64:3: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, shaped you and made your shapes beautiful, and to Him is the return.
64:4: He knows whatever is in the heavens and on the earth. He knows both what you conceal and what you reveal. Allah is the Knower of what is in the breasts.
64:5: Did the news of those who disbelieved before you not come to you? They tasted the evil consequence of their affair, and for them is a painful punishment.
64:6: This is because, when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they said, 'Shall a human guide us?' and so they disbelieved and turned away.
64:7: Those who disbelieved claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say: "Yes, by my Rabb, you will certainly be resurrected,
64:8: Believe in Allah, His messenger, and the light We have sent down. Allah is aware of what you do.
64:9: The day He gathers you for the Day of Gathering, that is the day of deception. Whoever believes in Allah and does righteous deeds, Allah will cover his evil deeds and admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, they will abide therein forever. That is the great success.
64:10: As for those who disbelieve and deny Our verses, they are the companions of the Fire, abiding therein forever. What an evil destination!
64:11: No disaster strikes except by the permission of Allah. Whoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart. Allah is the Knower of all things.
64:12: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; if you turn away, then upon Our messenger is only the clear proclamation.
64:13: Allah, there is no deity except Him, so let the believers rely only on Allah.
64:14: O you who believe! Indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them; and if you pardon, overlook, and forgive, indeed Allah is very forgiving, very merciful.
64:15: Indeed, your wealth and your children are a trial, and with Allah is a great reward.
64:16: So beware of Allah as much as you are able, listen, obey, and spend good for yourselves. Whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul, then those are the ones who attain salvation.
64:17: If you lend Allah a good loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you; and Allah is the One who rewards gratitude, al-Halim.
64:18: He is the Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Exalted in Might, the Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
